## Download

1. Download **MahjongSoul-Lovense.exe** below and put it in any folder.
2. Double-click it. A console window opens (keep it open while playing) and your browser opens the settings page.
   - Windows may show "Windows protected your PC" because the app isn't code-signed. Click **More info → Run anyway**.
3. Turn on **Game Mode** in Lovense Remote, copy its IP and port into *Lovense connection*, save, and click **Find toys**.
4. Click **Install userscript** (you need [Tampermonkey](https://www.tampermonkey.net/) first). Skip this if you already installed it for the Twitch app.

Your settings are saved in `%APPDATA%\MahjongSoulLovense`. Full setup steps are in the [README](https://github.com/BrooklynVRC/Mahjong-Soul-Lovense-Integration#readme).

Twitch viewer triggers need [Mahjong Soul Twitch Integration](https://github.com/BrooklynVRC/Mahjong-Soul-Twitch-Integration/releases/latest) running too.

🔞 Adults only.
